response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) as exec_count FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), type_shares AS (SELECT ordertune, exec_count, exec_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(exec_count) FROM type_counts) as share FROM type_counts), avg_share_val AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM type_shares) SELECT SUM(ts.exec_count) as sum_of_counts, AVG(ts.share) as average_share, AVG(ts.share - asv.avg_share) as average_excess FROM type_shares ts CROSS JOIN avg_share_val asv WHERE ts.share > asv.avg_share
